title: Independent compact certificate for the lost-free P112 bound
body:
## Result and scope

This gives PR3625's lost-free P112 bound a compact, independently checked proof object: 112 positive rationally weighted orthonormal eight-frames cover every actual selected port with exact weight one. Their total weight is 14, so the orthonormal-plane dimension argument in F2^9 gives |S| <= 4*14 = 56.

The bound is unchanged. Acceptance needs neither the predecessor's exhaustive 4,032-frame census and 288-fold incidences nor its transitivity calculation. Two separately authored standard-library implementations parse the selected raw source and check every frame and rational equality; no predecessor or discovery executable is imported.

The tariff check also isolates two prose discrepancies in the retained PR3625 README: under its fixed 72+2*(112-s) model, s=32 costs 232, and sizes 33–36 cost 230,228,226,224. Strictly beating 224 starts at 37. A different block invoice is not established here. At s<=56 the fixed-72 floor remains 184; a cheaper physical block, attainable maximum, supplier or new kappa is not claimed.

## Sources and overlap

Base and fresh canonical main: 20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90, priority revision 6. Public head: efe1d72e4dcd14c2c48693b8f3a8c66f23d539b0; tree c392765945279f4596bd2509582754edf9ef3375 matches the checked local tree.

Audited PR3625: 5cc87895e86a951d43f4725b122a4bcd2675bc43. Its README, receipt and 32-plane witness are retained unchanged with original commit/path/Git-blob/SHA256 records. Scientific replay requires only the selected main archive and the main copy-budget RESULT outside this package; it needs no pending Git history or network.

Repository picker nonce abd26268e2352963323cb91c9c701880 selected recursive interfaces. The coverage-law card is explicitly changed to this independent obstruction certificate. Live handoffs/Discussion1587, the ledger and targeted current/historical PRs were checked. PR3356/3373 concern disjoint packing; PR3373's excluded fourteen-frame partition was not searched. PR3370/3387 concern even-group repair; PR2484's fractional colouring concerns a fixed plane graph. Incomplete hidden Discussion coverage is recorded; no novelty guarantee is claimed.

Only research/p112-lost-free-fractional-cover is added: 14 files, 78,259 bytes. Frozen predecessors, upstream and the selected frontier are unchanged.

## Validation

    python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-lost-free-fractional-cover

Final local CPython3.12.14 registered replay passed in 1.4903 seconds, maximum child RSS76,759,040 bytes:

- 112 rational frames, 7,168 Gram entries and all112 exact incidence equations;
- sixteen primary plus nineteen separately authored dense-vector/schema controls, including missing r/r orthogonality and an exact 2^-100 weight fault;
- five actual optimized CLI corruptions and two positives on owned copies;
- the predecessor's 32-plane witness algebraically, with no physical-price admission.

All three scripts pass -I -O -Werror -B in a regular-only, inode-disjoint, read-only Git-free export with both external inputs, preserving source/export bytes and modes. Final committed-byte comparison passes on all16 package/input files. Warning-strict compilation and diff checks pass. The optional strict source-history gate declined the shallow checkout and is explicitly not reported as passed; the public aggregate has canonical base as its direct parent and all pending runtime bytes are retained.

The final validation-note addition is metadata; scientific export bytes match the final checked files. Ruff was unavailable. Original exhaustive census/isometries, solver <=51 evidence, selected supplier cold replay, native execution, Lean, Docker and human/formal acceptance are unrun. Hosted CI subsequently passed on this exact head: [plan and registered replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39133158980), completed at 13:51:38 UTC; the replay log contains all three package PASS markers and outcome=completed.

Discovery used already installed NumPy to propose support, followed by exact Fraction elimination. The public verifier is stdlib-only and the certificate is the acceptance evidence.

## Credit and next obligations

Credit Matarener/Mark and Claude for PR3625's theorem; Philippe Van Velzen for the family/witness/pricing; ctoth/Discussion1587; JosieElliston's copy budgets; Sagar Thakrar/PR2484; Nick Petalas/PR3356/3373; Tekalign/PR3370 and the retained E8/native/compiler/selected lineage. Prepared for ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separately authored AI checking and scope review. Apache-2.0.

A certified bound <=48 or an actual set >=49 would decide positive saving in the fixed-72 model. Any cheaper block needs its own complete physical access, restoration and consumer bill. Smaller-denominator certificates may aid review, but support minimality and 56-attainment remain open.
